provenance: Assistant-authored synthetic development evaluation, frozen before first run. Not independently human-labelled, not real listings, not an external test set.
relevance_rule: Relevant means property-specific evidence about the queried topic, including adverse experiences. Direction labels are for risk recall only. Nearby businesses and unrelated senses of keywords are distractors.

documents.text: Inside this apartment the bedroom was quiet after ten on the three nights I stayed.
With the windows shut, I slept through every night without hearing the road outside.
Construction noise woke me at six each weekday in this unit during my September stay.
隔壁住户凌晨练鼓，我在这套房里连续两晚被吵醒。
The apartment Wi-Fi carried my four afternoon video conferences without disconnecting.
During my stay, colleagues could see and hear me clearly throughout every remote team meeting.
Internet service in the unit failed twice during client calls last week.
在屋里远程开会时画面频繁卡住，最后只能用手机流量。
This unit has a full-size desk and an adjustable office chair in the second bedroom.
I could comfortably spread two monitors and my keyboard across the dedicated work surface in the apartment.
The advertised workspace is a narrow shelf; the desk cannot fit my laptop and notebook together.
这套房只能坐在没有靠背的高凳上用电脑，做了半天工作就腰酸。
The lease for this apartment includes one reserved parking space in the garage.
A numbered bay behind the building is assigned exclusively to the tenant's vehicle.
No tenant parking is provided, and overnight street parking is prohibited on this block.
住这里时每天回家都要绕几条街才找到能放车的位置。
A washer and dryer are installed inside this apartment and are included in the lease.
Residents can clean and tumble-dry their clothes in the shared basement room without leaving the building.
The building's only laundry room has been closed for repairs for three weeks.
楼内没有处理脏衣物的机器，我每周都得提着衣服去街角的自助店。
The Quiet Cup cafe across town advertises a new breakfast menu; this brochure says nothing about sound inside the rental.
The neighborhood music shop sells headphones branded Noise Free; no information about the building's acoustics is supplied.
The city bus network connects the district to downtown. This describes transport routes only.
An internet marketing company opened a branch nearby. This notice contains no information about service inside the property.
The office supplies shop on the next street sells desk calendars. The unit's furnishings are not described.
Collect the application from the leasing office reception desk. This is an administrative location, not a tenant work area.
A parking garage two miles away is featured in a city architecture exhibition. Tenant vehicle arrangements are unspecified.
The local theater is performing a comedy called Parking Wars this Friday; the ad gives no vehicle storage information.
The hardware store sells replacement washer seals for kitchen faucets. No clothes-cleaning appliances are described.
A nearby boutique sells jackets labelled dry clean only. The rental's facilities are not mentioned.
